items: SEBI Annual Report 2025-26 highlights Mutual Fund AUM (total market value of assets under management) expansion to ₹73.7 lakh crore and unique investor growth to 6.1 crore.

**Mutual Fund AUM (total market value of assets under management) Growth:** Indian Mutual Fund AUM (total market value of assets under management) grew from **₹31.43 lakh crore (March 2021)** to **₹73.7 lakh crore (March 2026)**.
**Unique Investors:** Unique MF investors surged to **6.1 crore**, up **13.2% YoY**.
**Macro Growth Estimates:** Real GDP growth estimated at **7.7% in FY26** (up from 7.1% in FY25); IMF projects **6.5% growth for FY27**.

≠ **AUM (total market value of assets under management) Growth:** Pay attention: MF AUM (total market value of assets under management) more than doubled over 5 years from ₹31.43L cr (2021) to ₹73.7L cr (2026).
